scan.library: CUB DeviceScan for modular sum; affine custom-op review pending

byte_accounting.required_bytes: bytes of source-observable required inputs plus outputs; reduction output is one u32 scalar; inclusive scan output is n u32 prefixes

byte_accounting.workspace_bytes: explicit backend temporary allocations; never credited to required bytes
